Which American presidents were in office during the Vietnam War?

query.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX res: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dbc: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Category:>
SELECT?uri WHERE {
 ?uri dct:subject dbc:Presidents_of_the_United_States.
 ?uri dbo:office?office.
 ?office dct:location res:United_States.
 ?office dbo:endTime?endTime.
 ?endTime dbo:inRange res:1955-1959.
 ?endTime dbo:inRange res:1961-1963.
 ?endTime dbo:inRange res:1969-1974.
  FILTER (?endTime > res:1954-01-01 &&?endTime < res:1975-01-01)
}

query.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX res: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
SELECT DISTINCT?string WHERE {
 ?x rdf:type dbo:MusicalGroup.
 ?x rdfs:label "Ramones"@en.
 ?x dbo:member?m.
 ?m dbo:member?song.
 ?song dbo:track?track.
 ?track dbo:track?string.
  FILTER (?string!=?track).
}

question.string: Which book has the most pages?

query.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT DISTINCT?uri
WHERE {
 ?uri rdf:type dbo:Book.
 ?uri dbo:numberOfPages?n.
  FILTER (?n > 0)
  ORDER BY DESC(?n)
  LIMIT 1
}

question.string: What is the largest state in the United States?
Give me the websites of companies with more than 500000 employees.

query.sparql:
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT distinct?web
WHERE {
 ?sub dbo:numberOfEmployees?obj.
 ?sub rdfs:label?name.
  FILTER (?name?name && str(?name)!= "" && xsd:integer(?obj) > 500000).
 ?sub foaf:homepage?web.
}

question.string: What were the names of the three ships by Columbus?

query.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dbc: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Category:]
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT?uri WHERE {
 ?uri rdf:type dbo:Ship.
 ?uri dct:subject dbc:Christopher_Columbus.
 ?uri dct:subject dbc:Exploration_ships.
 ?uri rdfs:label?name.
  FILTER (?name = "Santa Maria" ||?name = "Pinta" ||?name = "Niña")
}
